summary: Catalog of 109 cross-platform UI components (90 web, 19 React Native) with live previews; free SDK, paid kits.
description: The components catalog of OTF's SDK: 90 web components for React (Next.js, Vite, Remix) and 19 React Native components for Expo, dark-first, all with live previews, plus 17 token themes. The components are free and open source (MIT) and ship as npm packages under @otfdashkit/*; the same site sells $9 landing templates and $99+ full-stack kits.
